gen-dafont-capture-it-gf-noto-sans-hk: Dense, urban, nearly sealed shut. Noto Sans HK, a sans-serif with large lowercase forms and lifted brush ends, gives Capture It's compact letters room to breathe on the page.
gen-dafont-capture-it-gf-noto-sans-imper: Noto Sans Imperial Aramaic feels approachable, its c ends splayed apart like pincers. But Capture It stays nearly sealed, with every line drawn at the same weight against that openness.
gen-dafont-capture-it-gf-noto-sans-inscr: Urban and nearly sealed, Capture It meets Noto Sans Inscriptional Parthian, whose big eyes on every e and a stay open. Closed against open is the whole draw.
gen-dafont-capture-it-gf-noto-sans-jp: Capture It hits hard, urban, its letters nearly sealed shut and its x-height huge. But Noto Sans JP, a sans-serif with sweeping open curves, keeps paragraphs moving along smoothly.
gen-dafont-capture-it-gf-noto-sans-kaith: Urban, sealed-up, and thread-fine, Capture It draws every curve like wire. Yet Noto Sans Kaithi, a sans-serif with an open channel in each e, fills the line almost like capitals.
gen-dafont-capture-it-gf-noto-sans-kanna: Huge lowercase and curves with no tilted stress give Capture It a hard urban edge. And while Capture It commands, Noto Sans Kannada, a sans-serif, welcomes, its s curves open at both ends.
gen-dafont-capture-it-gf-noto-sans-kayah: Capture It draws its letters in a plain, unshaded line, nearly sealed and urban. Noto Sans Kayah Li, with brush ends lifted before curves close, feels tidier and quieter beside it.
gen-dafont-capture-it-gf-noto-sans-kharo: Capture It brings urban force through huge lowercase and letters nearly sealed shut, while Noto Sans Kharoshthi stays open. One hits hard; the other lays a dense dark lowercase band.
gen-dafont-capture-it-gf-noto-sans-khmer: Strokes with a pipe-cleaner look give Capture It its urban bite, with letters sealed nearly shut. Noto Sans Khmer, a sans-serif, keeps paragraphs flowing through wide chisel-notch openings.
gen-dafont-capture-it-gf-noto-sans-khojk: Capture It looks drawn with a single nib, urban and nearly sealed, its x-height huge. Noto Sans Khojki, with exits wide enough to pass light and a clear eye on every e, loosens things up beneath it.
